 Eastern Florida’s Concert Band Performance Time Changed
October 20, 2026 
 The Eastern Florida State College Performing and Visual Arts Department has announced
 that the time has changed for its Concert Band concert scheduled for Friday, Nov.
 20.
 Conducted by Jon Oxford, the concert will be held as follows:
 EFSC Concert Band – Friday, 20 at 6 p.m. 
 Tickets may be purchased in advance at efsc.booktix.com or at the door on the day
 of the concert via cash or credit card. Ticket prices include all applicable fees
 and are the same for cash or card purchases.
 General admission online in advance is $9 General Admission and $7 for Senior/Military
 Admission. Tickets purchased at the door are $10 General Admission and $8 for Senior/Military
 Admission.
 For more information, contact Jon Oxford at oxfordj@easternflorida.edu. 
 Media Contact: Suzanne Rains, APR, CPRC, Associate Vice President, Communications
 Office: 321-433-7022 
 Cell: 321-537-6986 
 Email: rainss@easternflorida.edu
